item.title: American College Of Education Gains New Bain Capital Double Impact Backing After CIC Partners Investment
item.description: CIC Partners announced it has successfully realized its investment in American College of Education, marking the end of a strategic partnership that began in 2020 and the start of ACE’s next phase of growth with a newly announced investment from Bain Capital Double Impact. item.title: TPG To Buy Majority Stake In Sabre Industries From Blackstone
item.description: TPG has signed definitive agreements to acquire a majority stake in Sabre Industries, a provider of engineered infrastructure solutions for electric transmission, telecom, and data center projects. The investment will be made through TPG Rise Climate, TPG’s dedicated climate investing platform. Funds managed by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners, which first invested in Sabre in 2021, will retain a significant minority stake and continue as a partner alongside TPG. item.description: Supra Elemental Recovery, a startup that spun out of engineering and natural sciences labs at The University of Texas at Austin, has launched with a $250,000 investment from Discovery to Impact’s UT Seed Fund as part of its pre-seed funding round. item.title: AT&T Launches Kid-Focused Smartphone With Parent Controls
item.description: AT&T has introduced the AT&T amiGO Jr. Phone, positioning it as the first kid-focused smartphone offered by a wireless provider and designed to help parents stay connected to children while adding safeguards for everyday use. The company said the launch is aimed at families with earlier and more frequent device access, noting that a significant portion of its customer base is parents. item.title: Google Gemini Surpasses 750 Million Monthly Active Users
item.description: Google says the Gemini app has surpassed 750 million monthly active users, a milestone the company disclosed in CEO Sundar Pichai’s prepared remarks for Alphabet’s Q4 2025 earnings call. In the transcript, Pichai said the Gemini user base has grown alongside “significantly higher engagement per user,” which he tied to the December launch of Gemini 3. The post Google Gemini Surpasses 750 Million Monthly Active Users appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: Amazon: Dharmesh Mehta Named As Andy Jassy’s Next Technical Advisor
item.description: Amazon announced that Dharmesh Mehta, vice president of Worldwide Selling Partner Services, will become CEO Andy Jassy’s new Technical Advisor (TA) in March, while Amit Agarwal, senior vice president of International Emerging Stores, will expand his responsibilities to lead the Selling Partner Services (SPS) organization. item.title: Cetera Brings In $75 Million Firm Fortress Financial
item.description: Cetera has recruited longtime independent financial advisor Neil Henning, who is moving to the firm after more than 23 years affiliated with Commonwealth Financial Network. Based in New Jersey and North Carolina, Henning and his Fortress Financial wealth management team oversee approximately $75 million in assets under administration and are joining Cetera’s Summit Financial Networks community. item.title: Ashton Thomas Private Wealth Adds Collin Rigler As Managing Director, Partner, And Private Wealth Advisor
item.description: Ashton Thomas Private Wealth, a wealth management firm backed by Arax Investment Partners, announced Collin Rigler has joined the firm as managing director, partner, and private wealth advisor, alongside Eric Montijo as director and private wealth advisor, as the company continues expanding its advisor roster across the Southwest and West Coast. item.title: Steward Partners Adds $630 Million Macon Team to Expand In Georgia
item.description: Steward Partners is expanding its presence in Georgia with the addition of a three-partner advisory team in Macon that oversees approximately $630 million in client assets. The move strengthens the firm’s footprint in Central Georgia and continues its strategy of recruiting established wealth management teams seeking independence, equity ownership, and a client-first operating model supported by a national platform. item.title: myFootpath Partners With Western Colorado University
item.description: myFootpath has entered a new partnership with Western Colorado University aimed at bringing adult and returning learners back to higher education and improving degree completion among students who previously stopped out before earning a credential. The collaboration focuses on reconnecting with former students and creating clearer, more accessible pathways to completing a degree.
